gbm_population_evidence.quote: Pathological examination confirming cases of WHO Grade 4 glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) with a new diagnosis.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Survivin-loaded dendritic cell injection (other names: Targeted Survivin DC cell therapy)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Phase I Clinical Study of Targeted Survivin DC Cell Injection for the Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Primary Glioblastoma Multiforme (GBM)

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Survivin-loaded dendritic cell injection (other names: Targeted Survivin DC cell therapy)

agents.drug_class_hint: survivin-targeted dendritic cell vaccine (PERCELLVAC-Sur), cell therapy

role_evidence.quote: Patients will undergo a combined treatment of radiotherapy and temozolomide (TMZ) for a duration of 6 weeks, with concurrent chemotherapy.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent (established GBM therapy), standard chemoradiation and adjuvant

role_evidence.quote: Four hours before the administration, the injection sites will be pre-treated with lidocaine cream.

source_quote.quote: Positive expression of Survivin in immunohistochemistry testing.

coder_notes: Only investigational agent is a survivin-loaded dendritic cell vaccine (excluded intervention type); temozolomide is standard Stupp backbone given to all; lidocaine cream is pre-treatment of injection sites (supportive, described in brief summary only). Survivin IHC positivity is an entry requirement and is mechanistically linked to the DC vaccine, but the vaccine is not a candidate, so candidate_matched false. Immune endpoints (survivin-specific T-cell responses, cytokines) relate to the non-candidate vaccine, so target_engagement_planned coded no. cns5_terminology historical ('WHO Grade 4 glioblastoma multiforme', no IDH requirement).
